en.tidy-a-little.title: Tidy a little
en.tidy-a-little.description: From putting one thing back after dinner to five minutes that keep a few spots of your home clear, one area at a time.
en.tidy-a-little.why: Why do you want a tidier home? In your own words.
en.tidy-a-little.moment: a moment after a meal at home
en.tidy-a-little.build.v1: A fire to come home to
en.tidy-a-little.build.v2: A tent with everything in reach
en.tidy-a-little.build.v3: A hut with a clear table
en.tidy-a-little.build.v5: A house where things have a place
en.tidy-a-little.one-thing.action: put one thing back where it belongs
en.tidy-a-little.one-thing.arrival: It starts with one thing in its place. The first piece stands.
en.tidy-a-little.one-thing.accept: One thing finds its place easily now. You could give the table five minutes.
en.tidy-a-little.one-thing.nugget: You could pick the one thing while you are still eating. Getting up from the table is then the moment to carry it back.
en.tidy-a-little.table.action: tidy the table for five minutes, with a timer
en.tidy-a-little.table.arrival: A clear table. What you started has a little more room now.
en.tidy-a-little.table.accept: The table clears quickly now. You could carry on to the kitchen counter in the same five minutes.
en.tidy-a-little.table.nugget: You could keep the timer where you eat. When it rings you are done, whatever is left. Stopping on time keeps the step small enough for tomorrow.
en.tidy-a-little.counter.action: tidy the kitchen counter after the table, five minutes in all
en.tidy-a-little.counter.arrival: Two clear spots, and it keeps growing from the middle outwards.
en.tidy-a-little.counter.accept: Table and counter fit into your five minutes. You could add one more spot that you choose.
en.tidy-a-little.counter.nugget: You could give things that keep landing on the counter a home close by, such as a bowl for keys or a hook. A thing with a home is put away in seconds.
en.tidy-a-little.one-more.action: tidy one more spot of my choice after table and counter, five minutes in all
en.tidy-a-little.one-more.arrival: One more piece, chosen by you, and the round is whole.
en.tidy-a-little.one-more.accept: Your five minutes have a shape now.
en.tidy-a-little.one-more.nugget: You could plan for a full evening now: "If guests stay or I am tired, then I will put one thing back." The smaller step still counts.
en.tidy-a-little.ending: After dinner, five minutes go by themselves now: the table, the counter and the spot you chose.
